name: The Super Egg-O-Matic

meta.next: A Bad Egg, A Fine Egg, An Extraordinary Egg, An Ordinary Egg

summary: Curgle Cranklehop's newest invention is an impressive piece of machinery, and it sputters wildly when you reach its control panel. Hippogryph eggs go into it.

sections.title: A Machine of Curgle Cranklehop
sections.body: Curgle Cranklehop's newest invention makes an impressive sight. When you walk up to its control panel it sputters wildly. It is built to take a hippogryph egg, and the eggs are to be found in the mountains of southern Feralas, around the Ruins of Isildien.

sections.title: What the Machine Does
sections.body: Place a hippogryph egg inside and the machine answers with a run of beeps and odd mechanical noises. Its Eggometer weighs and measures the egg, then packages it up, all in very quick service. What comes out is an Egg Crate, which holds an egg of some variety.

faq.answer: Curgle Cranklehop, whose latest invention it is.

faq.q: What does the machine need to operate?
aliases: what do i give the egg-o-matic
faq.answer: A hippogryph egg, which you place into the machine.

faq.q: Where do you find hippogryph eggs?
faq.answer: Up in the mountains of southern Feralas, around the Ruins of Isildien.
